primary.title: How to Maximize Memory Efficiency and Reduce Costs on NVIDIA Jetson
primary.summary: Memory optimization can unlock bigger AI models on lower-cost NVIDIA Jetson SKUs. By reducing software overhead, choosing efficient inference runtimes, and quantizing models, developers can make room for more AI - and reduce hardware costs. In this livestream, NVIDIA partners RidgeRun and Connect Tech will share demos and lessons learned on memory optimization, covering model quantization, efficient inference runtimes, and NVIDIA Jetson Agent Skills. You’ll see how large vision-language models fit into less memory and how a real robotics application moved to a more cost-efficient Jetson SKU. Y

primary.title: Learn to build better AI Agents through better context
primary.summary: Learn More: https://bit.ly/4yy5iWP The longer an agent works, the more repeated, contradictory, or stale information builds up in its context. Models perform worse as their context grows, a problem Jeff Huber and his team at Chroma named Context Rot. In our new course, Context Engineering, taught by Jeff Huber alongside guest speaker Drew Breunig, you'll build agent harnesses from scratch in Python and learn to give agents the right information, in the right format, at the right time. In this course, you'll learn: - Agentic search: Retrieve data with multiple search tools from different source

primary.title: How to Build Your Own AI Agent (Like PewDiePie)
primary.summary: PewDiePie is building his own AI assistant, Odysseus, and training a local model, Ajax, to power it. In this video I break down what Odysseus is, how an agent harness works from scratch, what it actually means to run a model locally with llama.cpp and Hugging Face, and how you can fine-tune a small model like Qwen 3.5 9B on agent traces so it calls tools reliably in your own harness. --- 🔗 *Links* - Odysseus (GitHub): https://github.com/odysseus-dev/odysseus - Claude system prompts: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/system-prompts - Hugging Face models: https://huggingface.co/
